jobs.description: OUR COMPANYBoehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionDo you have a keen sense for navigating complex legal matters and want to contribute to securing freedom to operate and defending market exclusivity for highly innovative pharmaceuticals?Are you excited by the prospect of taking on responsibility and working in a highly dynamic environment as part of the Corporate Department of Boehringer Ingelheim being responsible for intellectual property?In this exciting position located in Ingelheim, you will play a key role in supporting our human pharma and animal health business in bringing innovative products to the patients in need.Join us to shape the future of Boehringer Ingelheim!Tasks & responsibilities- In this role, you will leverage your extensive legal expertise to mitigate launch risks from third party patents for our newly developed products as well as to enforce and defend our patents to defend our products against patent infringement.- With a strategic mindset, you will develop complex launch risk mitigation strategies in a cross functional set up and provide tailored advice to the business how to leverage upside potential from our existing patent portfolios.- Managing and instructing our network of external lawyers and patent attorneys in disputes including in-court infringement and nullity proceedings will be a key part of your responsibilities.- In addition, you will support the negotiation and drafting of complex agreements to find the best possible solutions for Boehringer Ingelheim.Requirements- Fully qualified lawyer, preferably with honors in the second state examination. An additional qualification (LL.M. or comparable degree with a focus on IP law) is desirable- Longterm specialization in the field of intellectual property and the pharmaceutical industry at an international level as well as extensive experience in managing large international IP portfolios- Longterm relevant professional experience in external law firms specialized on patent litigation or in a comparable in-house position as a corporate counsel- Experience in leading, coordinating, and managing patent litigation- Knowledge and experience in the pharmaceutical industry- Strong strategic understanding and the ability to quickly grasp and clearly present legally and technically complex matters- High level of teamwork and excellent communication skills in English and GermanWhat we offerWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until November 22, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand.Step 2: Virtual meetingStep 3: On-site interviewsPlease include the following documents when applying for this position: References (e.g. high school diploma, university degree certificate and employment references)

StellenbeschreibungBei Kelvion ist es unsere Mission, den industriellen Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit fördern. Von der Optimierung von Rechenzentren und der Weiterentwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion bis hin zur Revolutionierung von Kühl- und Klimatechniksystemen – unsere entscheidenden thermischen Lösungen stärken Branchen auf der ganzen Welt. Vereint als „One Kelvion“ liefert unser globales Team innovative Lösungen, die den Erfolg unserer Kunden voranbringen und eine nachhaltige Zukunft unterstützen.Kelvion – Gemeinsam gestalten wir die ZukunftZur Verstärkung unserer Abteilung Global Sales & Solutions innerhalb der Kelvion Machine Cooling Systems GmbH am Standort in Herne**** suchen wir ab sofort die Position des:GSE Service Sales Engineer (m/w/d)Ihre Aufgaben- Sie beraten Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen und entwickeln passgenaue Lösungen für Neuentwicklungen, Service-, Retrofit-, Ersatzteil- und Modernisierungsbedarfe- Sie sind verantwortlich für die kommerzielle und technische Angebotserstellung und unterstützen aktiv den Außendienst- Mithilfe von Market Intelligence analysieren Sie Kundenbedarfe im Aftermarket sowie im Neugeschäft, identifizieren Service- und Vertriebspotenziale und leiten daraus konkrete Geschäftschancen ab- Sie wirken aktiv an der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Neugeschäftsaktivitäten mit, insbesondere durch technische Beratung, Angebotsausarbeitung und Unterstützung bei der Gewinnung neuer Kunden und Projekte- Sie bearbeiten Kundenspezifikationen und klären den erforderlichen Lieferumfang unter Berücksichtigung von Servicefähigkeit, Ersatzteilverfügbarkeit und kundenspezifischen Anlagenbedingungen- Sie führen thermodynamische Kalkulationen und verfahrenstechnische Auslegungen durch und wählen geeignete Subkomponenten aus- Sie betreuen vorhandene Kunden und Key Accounts in technischen Fragestellungen, bauen langfristige Servicebeziehungen aus und unterstützen bei der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer Servicekonzepte- Sie ermitteln das hinter konkreten Applikationen stehende Kunden-, Markt- und Servicepotenzial- Sie arbeiten eng mit Service, Engineering, Vertriebs- und Serviceprozesse sowie die Standardisierung von Angeboten, Kalkulationen und DokumentationenIhre Qualifikation- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Investitionsgüter, idealerweise ergänzt um Erfahrung im Service-, Aftermarket- oder Retrofit-Geschäft sowie im Design von Wärmetauschern und der Wärmeübertragung im Energiebereich (z. B. Großmotoren)- Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für industrielle Anlagen, Serviceprozesse, Ersatzteilgeschäft und kundenspezifische Modernisierungslösungen- Systematische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Einsatz- und Reisebereitschaft- Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Angebotserstellung und Vertragsverhandlung sowie Kenntnisse in der Durchführung thermodynamischer Berechnungen (HTRI-Kenntnisse wünschenswert)- Kundenorientiertes Auftreten, Verhandlungsgeschick und die Fähigkeit, technische Anforderungen in wirtschaftlich attraktive Serviceangebote zu überführen- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und sichere Anwenderkenntnisse im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Produkten und CRM-SystemenWir bietenWir bei Kelvion leben von der Zusammenarbeit, begrüßen die Gedankenvielfalt und schätzen jede Stimme. Innerhalb von Kelvion kommt die Kreativität zum Vorschein, weil den Menschen zugehört wird, ihre Beiträge anerkannt und ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen werden. Unser flexibler Ansatz für die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, stellt die Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit der Menschen in den Vordergrund und fördert das Engagement und die Karrieremöglichkeiten. Wir geben engagierten Menschen die Möglichkeit, sich weiterzuentwickeln und ihren eigenen Weg innerhalb des Unternehmens zu gehen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft, indem wir unsere globalen Teams dazu bringen, als „One Kelvion“ zu handeln.- Ein sehr gutes und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit einem motivierten Team- Eine Ihrem Erfahrungs- und Ausbildungsstand angemessene Vergütung nach TV M+E inkl. aller tariflichen Zusatzleistungen- Wöchentliche Arbeitszeit von 38 Std./Woche im Rahmen eines Gleitzeitmodells und 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr- Mobiles Arbeiten auf Basis unserer Konzern-Betriebsvereinbarung- Eine vom Arbeitgeber unterstützte betriebliche Altersvorsorge- Gute persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten- Ein Tätigkeitsumfeld mit zukunftsweisenden TechnologienHaben wir Ihr Interesse an einer vielseitigen Tätigkeit bei uns geweckt?Dann freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung!English Version﻿Our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.Together, We Shape the FutureTo strengthen our Global Sales & Solutions department within Kelvion Machine Cooling Systems GmbH at the Herne site, we are looking for a:GSE Service Sales Engineer (m/f/d)Your task- You will advise customers on technical issues and develop tailor-made solutions for new developments, service, retrofit, spare parts and modernization requirements- You will be responsible for the commercial and technical preparation of quotations and actively support the sales force- Using market intelligence, you will analyze customer needs in the aftermarket as well as in new business, identify service and sales potential and derive concrete business opportunities from this- You will actively participate in the development and implementation of new business activities, in particular through technical advice, proposal preparation and support in the acquisition of new customers and projects- You will process customer specifications and clarify the required scope of supply, taking into account serviceability, spare parts availability and customer-specific plant conditions- You will carry out thermodynamic calculations and process engineering designs and select suitable subcomponents- You will support customers and key accounts on technical matters, expand long-term service relationships and support the development of customer-specific service concepts- You will determine the customer, market and service potential behind specific applications- They work closely with service, engineering, production, order processing and external sales organizations to ensure technically and economically convincing solutions- You will support the further development of sales and service processes as well as the standardization of offers, calculations and documentationYour qualifications- Completed studies in the field of mechanical engineering, process engineering or industrial engineering- Several years of professional experience in the sale of capital goods requiring explanation, ideally supplemented by experience in the service, aftermarket or retrofit business as well as in the design of heat exchangers and heat transfer in the energy sector (e.g. large engines)- Strong technical understanding of industrial plants, service processes, spare parts business and customer-specific modernization solutions- Systematic and structured way of working as well as willingness to work and travel- Sound knowledge and experience in the areas of quotation preparation and contract negotiation as well as knowledge in the execution of thermodynamic calculations (HTRI knowledge desirable)- Customer-oriented appearance, negotiation skills and the ability to translate technical requirements into economically attractive service offerings- Very good written and spoken English skills and confident user skills in dealing with common MS Office products and CRM systemsWhat you can expect from usAt Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company. Together we shape a brighter future, engaging our global teams to act as “One Kelvion”.- A very good and collegial working environment with a motivated team- Remuneration according to TV M+E appropriate to your level of experience and training, including all additional benefits under the collective bargaining agreement- Weekly working hours of 38 hours/week as part of a flexitime model and 30 days of vacation per year- Mobile working on the basis of our Group Works Agreement- An employer-supported company pension scheme- Good personal development opportunities- An operating environment with cutting-edge technologiesInterested in a varied and exciting opportunity with us?Then we look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Techniker/in – 10x Genomics / Single-Cell Sequencing (Techniker/in - Biotechnik/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities- Perform end-to-end single-cell sequencing workflows, including sample processing, single-cell dissociation, single-nucleus preparation, cell sorting, quality assessment, and library preparation.- Execute and optimize single-cell experiments using platforms such as 10x Genomics, PARSE, or other single-cell technologies.- Conduct molecular biology experiments including PCR, qPCR, nucleic acid extraction/purification, and NGS-related workflows.- Handle human and mouse tissue samples and optimize protocols for challenging samples to improve experimental performance and data quality.- Operate laboratory instruments including flow cytometers (FACS), cell counters, PCR/qPCR systems, and other molecular biology equipment.- Analyze experimental results, maintain accurate laboratory records, prepare reports, and communicate findings with internal teams and customers when required.- Troubleshoot experimental issues, improve laboratory workflows, and contribute to the development and validation of single-cell methodologies.- Collaborate with research teams and support the training or supervision of junior team members when needed.Requirements- PhD degree in Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, or related fields,- or a Master’s degree with 1–3 years of relevant hands-on laboratory experience.- Hands-on experience with single-cell sequencing platforms (10x Genomics or equivalent) and related experimental workflows.Experience in:- Single-cell suspension preparation and tissue dissociation (human/mouse tissues)- Single-nucleus extraction/preparation- Flow cytometry/FACS operation- Molecular biology techniques including PCR, qPCR, purification, and NGS workflows- Experience with protocol optimization, troubleshooting, and laboratory SOPs.- Familiarity with organoids, recombinant AAV, screening, or low-input molecular assays is a plus.- Basic experience with data analysis tools (e.g., Prism, Spotfire, or equivalent) and interest in bioinformatics is preferred.- Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a research environment.- Willingness to travel when required.- Proficiency in English (written and spoken).------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Ihre Aufgaben- Durchführung von Single-Cell-Sequencing-Workflows von A bis Z, einschließlich Probenverarbeitung, Einzelzell-Dissoziation, Einzelkernpräparation, Zellsortierung, Qualitätskontrolle und Library Preparation. - Durchführung und Optimierung von Single-Cell-Experimenten mit Plattformen wie 10x Genomics, PARSE oder vergleichbaren Single-Cell-Technologien. - Durchführung molekularbiologischer Arbeiten, einschließlich PCR, qPCR, Nukleinsäureextraktion und -aufreinigung sowie weiterer NGS-bezogener Workflows. - Arbeiten mit humanen und murinen Gewebeproben sowie Optimierung von Protokollen für anspruchsvolle Proben, um die experimentelle Leistung und Datenqualität zu verbessern. - Bedienung und Wartung von Laborgeräten, insbesondere Durchflusszytometern (FACS), Zellzählern, PCR-/qPCR-Systemen und weiteren Geräten der Molekularbiologie. - Analyse und Dokumentation experimenteller Ergebnisse, Führung präziser Laboraufzeichnungen, Erstellung von Berichten sowie Kommunikation der Ergebnisse mit internen Teams und bei Bedarf mit Kunden. - Fehleranalyse und Troubleshooting bei experimentellen Problemen sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Laborabläufen und Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung und Validierung von Single-Cell-Methoden. - Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungs- und Projektteams sowie bei Bedarf Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung und Betreuung von Junior-Teammitgliedern. - Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen. Ihr Profil- Promotion (PhD) in Zellbiologie, Molekularbiologie, Biotechnologie oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet oder ein Masterabschluss mit 1–3 Jahren einschlägiger praktischer Laborerfahrung.  - Praktische Erfahrung mit Single-Cell-Sequencing-Plattformen, idealerweise 10x Genomics, sowie mit den entsprechenden experimentellen Workflows. - Praktische Erfahrung in folgenden Bereichen: - Herstellung von Einzelzellsuspensionen und Gewebedissoziation aus humanen und murinen Geweben - **Extraktion und Präparation von Einzelkernen (Single Nuclei)** - Bedienung von Durchflusszytometern / FACS - Molekularbiologische Methoden, einschließlich PCR, qPCR, Nukleinsäureaufreinigung und NGS-Workflows- Protokolloptimierung, Troubleshooting und Erstellung bzw. Anwendung von Labor-SOPs - Erfahrung mit Organoiden, rekombinantem AAV, Screening-Verfahren oder Low-Input-Molekularassays ist von Vorteil. - Grundkenntnisse in Datenanalyse-Tools wie Prism, Spotfire oder vergleichbaren Programmen sowie Interesse an Bioinformatik sind wünschenswert. - Gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem wissenschaftlichen Forschungsumfeld. - Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Zwingend erforderlich: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), Laborarbeiten, Labortechnik, Extrahieren, Extraktgewinnung

jobs.description: Du willst einen Job, bei dem deine Arbeit wirklich zählt, du gut verdienst und dich auf verlässliche Strukturen verlassen kannst? Full-time/Part-time (min. 32h/w) | Dresden | Hybrid (regular mobile work possible)Do you have a passion for high-quality software development and clean, maintainable code?Are you excited about applying machine learning, image processing, and pattern recognition to develop innovative solutions for medical and diagnostic applications?Do you enjoy transforming complex data into intelligent algorithms while working at the intersection of software engineering, AI, and life sciences?Dive into our AI!Your tasks You will take algorithms from research into real-world applications:• You’ll explore new machine learning approaches for holographic microscopy.• You’ll help shape our device design together with our hardware and optics experts, ensuring that the device captures the data your algorithms need.• Together with our biomedical experts, you’ll plan how data is collected and annotated.• You’ll build in-house tools that support colleagues across the company with annotation, calibration, and analysis.• You’ll dive into the data to identify what is holding a model back, whether it’s the data, the optics, or the algorithm itself.• You’ll own your algorithms end to end: developing, documenting, rigorously testing, and optimizing them to run efficiently on our embedded devices.Our current focus is on improving our holographic microscopy-based devices, although spectrometry occasionally comes into play. Our current models determine cell concentration and viability without staining, and detect and classify blood cells, crystals, bacteria, and casts in urine. We train them on both clinical data and simulations and deploy them on embedded GPUs, where every millisecond and megabyte counts. They already power our medical devices and research instruments, and we have several exciting applications in the pipeline.Your profileYou...• have a degree in computer science, engineering, natural sciences, or a related quantitative discipline• write clean, maintainable Python code and care about code quality• have extensive hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks• have a strong foundation in computer vision, deep learning, and statistical analysis• have experience bringing machine learning models from research into real-world products• are familiar with modern software engineering practices and tools (Linux, Git, Docker, CI/CD)• enjoy explaining technical concepts to colleagues from other disciplines and learning from them• communicate fluently in English; German is a plus• work in a structured manner and take ownership of your resultsBonus points if you...• have deployed and optimized machine learning models on embedded systems (ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA, C++)• have applied computer vision in biomedical, life science, or diagnostic applications• are familiar with holographic microscopy or have a solid foundation in optical imaging and signal processing• have built web-based tools, for example for data annotation and analysis• have experience developing machine learning algorithms for medical applications in accordance with IEC 62304 and the EU AI Act• are able to use AI-assisted development tools effectively while fully understanding and owning your codeYour benefits• An exciting MedTech environment with a meaningful societal impact• Plenty of opportunities to contribute your own ideas and benefit from short decision-making paths• A modern infrastructure and engaging technical challenges• Flexible working hours and the option to work remotely on 2-3 days• 30 days of annual vacation plus MyFlextime for additional time off• An attractive compensation package, including a contribution to the company pension scheme• Personal and professional development opportunities• Interdisciplinary collaboration within a dedicated and supportive team• One team day every six months, as well as regular company events throughout the year to strengthen team spirit and foster cross-functional collaboration• Two paid waiting days for illness for you and your children• 50€ subsidy toward a JobTicket or Germany Ticket• Modern office workstations with ergonomic equipment• Complimentary beverages, fresh fruit, and specialty coffeeSounds interesting? We are a German MedTech company that develops point-of-care devices for the fast, reliable and cost-effective analysis of liquids, the so-called fluidlabs.
